protocol: Frozen estimator before acquiring unseen take03/take06 at three IRIS pendulum release settings. Source2..10s, initial65% physical/geometry fitting, remaining35% forecast. First-frame-only fixed ROI rule. All six attempted; no hyperparameter tuning on these clips.
scope: Held-out recording transfer relative to RealityForge development clips, not official IRIS split or independent manual tracking truth. Known dynamics family specified for parameter comparison; automatic selection evaluated separately.
limitations: Errors are against automatically extracted image tracks.
Nominal rope length0.5m is not exact pivot-to-bob-center effective length.
No damping ground truth or calibrated uncertainty coverage for these recordings.
Published recurrence comparator adapts observed angles; it is not full EndPhys reproduction.
Network trained only on synthetic data; no IRIS frames or parameters used in training.
